summary: Full E2E test of Habit Circle. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (auth signup/signin/me/cookie, dup email 400, bad pw 401, unauth 401, habits create/defaults, mine-only-own, community-only-shared, private 404 for other user on GET/comments/ticks, tick/untick/idempotent, streak logic, bad dates 400, non-owner tick 403, comments with author name, empty comment 422/400). Frontend: all requested flows checked with Playwright. Sign up A/B lands on /habits; sign out goes to /signin; sign in lands on /habits; signed-out visits to protected pages redirect to /signin; share checkbox unticked by default and reset after add; Shared/Private tags show; 7 checkboxes with local dates, today first; tick/untick updates Days done and Current streak and persists after reload; Community shows only shared habits with owner, when text and Days done; B's checkboxes are disabled; B's comment shows to A with B's name; B opening A's private habit URL sees 'Habit not found'; top nav and sidebar links work; sidebar hidden on mobile. One minor UX issue: the Sonner toast at top-right covers the header Sign out button (and the whole header on mobile) for a few seconds, so clicks are blocked.

minor.issue: Accepts future dates up to 8 days ahead (abs() check). Not reachable from the UI.
allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True reflects any origin. Explicit origins are recommended.
No brute-force lockout (playbook item). The user asked to keep it simple, so this is informational only.

ui_bugs.issue: The top-right 'Habit added' toast sits over the header Sign out button, so clicks are blocked for about 4s. On mobile it covers the whole header nav.

issues: The 'My habits' nav link stays active on the habit page, including when viewing another user's shared habit opened from Community (NavLink without end). Cosmetic.

action_items: Move the Toaster to bottom-right (or offset it) so it does not cover the header Sign out button and nav
Optional: limit the tick date range to [today-8, today+1] instead of abs() <= 8
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS reflects any origin with credentials enabled. Use explicit origins from env.
HabitPage does not reset habit/error state when the id param changes. Minor.
The bcrypt hash uses gensalt, so it has the $2b$ format. The httpOnly cookie is set with Secure and SameSite=None (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 minor UX issue)

test_credentials: No seeded users. Tests create users test_<hex>@example.com / ui_a_<hex>@example.com, password pass123
seed_data_creation: Test users/habits/comments created with TEST_ / UI prefixes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_habit_tracker.py. Radix checkboxes expose data-state=checked/unchecked. The browser date matched the server date in testing.
